title: Public summary
text: DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. Dar Global PLC is a highly differentiated international real estate business and luxury developer.

title: Public summary
text: DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, marked its fifth anniversary as a USD 23 billion global real estate platform. It launched DarGlobal Capital Partners, its asset management platform, and is advancing real estate tokenization initiatives. DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.

title: Public summary
text: Dar Global is expanding into Saudi Arabia. Its parent company, Dar Al Arkan, has a long track record of delivering high quality real estate projects in the Kingdom. Dar Global aims to promote and sell luxury Saudi projects to an international clientele.

title: Public summary
text: DarGlobal is a London Stock Exchange listed developer that builds high end residential projects in Dubai. The listing mandates audits, regular performance reporting and adherence to UK corporate governance standards.

title: Public summary
text: Dar Global was established in 2017 and listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange on 28 February 2023. In 2024 it unveiled ten landmark luxury projects across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman and Spain with a combined value above US$1.9 billion. Its clients come from over 100 nationalities.

title: Public summary
text: Dar Global launched Trump Tower Jeddah, a SAR 2 billion project. Dar Global was originally established to house and develop the international assets of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development, a leading Saudi developer.

title: Public summary
text: Dar Global began construction on Tierra Viva in Spain, AIDA in Oman, and Les Vagues in Qatar in December 2023. Tierra Viva in Marbella was unveiled with a partnership with Lamborghini.

title: Public summary
text: Wasalt is a joint venture between Saudi developer Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding, a technology startup incubator. It is a real estate platform with a website and app specialising in real estate brokerage. Offerings include online solutions for real estate and rental markets, access to property specialists, mortgage provider options, and digital technology to visit properties and finalise transactions.

title: Public summary
text: Wasalt is Saudi Arabia's AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers. Users can buy, rent, explore projects, list properties for sale or rent, list daily rentals, and join government and private real estate auctions. Wasalt partners with Infath for auctions and with propgenius.ai for AI tools.

title: Public summary
text: Wasalt is licensed by REGA as a real estate portal and by Infath as a real estate auction platform. It launched Matchmaker Packages and Wasalt Business.

title: Public summary
text: Wasalt has more than 750,000 users and offers AI tools to create property descriptions, generate social media content, access property valuations, predict ROI and receive leads in Saudi Arabia's real estate market. Ziad El Chaar is Chairman of Wasalt.

title: Public summary
text: Christie's International Real Estate launched in Saudi Arabia in partnership with Wasalt, a subsidiary of Quara Holding Group. Wasalt provides AI-driven property search, client-agent matchmaking, Wasalt Projects and auctions.
